ps aux | grep -i redis; echo ---; ss -ltnp | grep -E '6379|6380'; echo ---; ls -la /etc/redis-old /etc/redis /opt/redis-7.2/bin /opt 2>/dev/null

which redis-cli redis-server; redis-cli -p 6380 info server | head -20; echo =====OLD; /opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 info server | head -20; echo =====OLD_MODULES; /opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 info modules; echo =====OLD_KEYSPACE; /opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 info keyspace; echo =====NEW_KEYSPACE; redis-cli -p 6380 info keyspace; echo =====OLD_REPL; /opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 info replication; echo =====; ls /usr/local/lib/redis/modules/
redis-cli -p 6380 replicaof 127.0.0.1 6379; sleep 2; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication; echo =====; redis-cli -p 6380 info keyspace

redis-cli -p 6380 info server | grep -E 'redis_version|executable|config_file'; ls -la /var/lib/redis /run/redis 2>/dev/null; redis-cli -p 6380 CONFIG GET masterauth; redis-cli -p 6380 CONFIG GET replica-serve-stale-data

sleep 5; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication | grep -E 'role|link_status|sync_in|offset'; echo =====; redis-cli -p 6380 info keyspace; echo =====; tail -5 /var/log/redis/redis.log; echo =====MASTER_LOG; tail -5 /var/log/redis-old/redis.log

redis-cli -p 6380 replicaof no one; redis-cli -p 6380 config set replica-read-only no; sleep 1; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication | grep -E 'role|master_host|slave_read_only|slave_read_repl'; echo =====; redis-cli -p 6380 info keyspace; echo =====; redis-cli -p 6379 info replication | grep -E 'role|connected_slaves'
python3 -c "import redis; print(redis.__version__)" 2>&1; /opt/kv-grader/bin/python -c "import redis; print(redis.__version__)" 2>&1; cat /opt/kv-seed/kvdump.py

redis-cli -p 6380 --scan --pattern '*' | wc -l; echo ---STREAMS_OLD; /opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 --scan | while read k; do t=$(/opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 type "$k"); [ "$t" = stream ] && echo "$k"; done; echo ---WRITE_TEST; redis-cli -p 6380 set __migration_write_test ok; redis-cli -p 6380 get __migration_write_test; redis-cli -p 6380 del __migration_write_test; echo ---MASTER_STATE; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication | grep -E 'role|master_host|slave_read_only'; redis-cli -p 6380 info persistence | grep -E 'rdb_last_bgsave_status|rdb_changes_since'; redis-cli -p 6380 ping
grep -n -i "digest\|save\|write\|json" /opt/kv-seed/seed_old.py | head; find / -name "*digest*" -o -name "*seed*digest*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v proc | head; ls -la /opt/kv-seed

cat /var/lib/kv-seed/old.digest; cd /opt/kv-seed && python3 -c "
import kvdump
d_old = kvdump.digest(kvdump.dump_server(6379))
d_new = kvdump.digest(kvdump.dump_server(6380))
expected = open('/var/lib/kv-seed/old.digest').read().strip()
print('seed-time digest:', expected)
print('old server now  :', d_old, d_old == expected)
print('new server now  :', d_new, d_new == expected)
"

/opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 info keyspace; redis-cli -p 6380 info keyspace; echo ---; redis-cli -p 6380 info persistence | grep -E 'rdb_last_bgsave|aof_enabled'; echo ---stream_groups_new; for k in events:00 events:07 events:19; do redis-cli -p 6380 xinfo groups "$k"; done

redis-cli -p 6380 config get replicaof; redis-cli -p 6380 config get replica-read-only; grep -iE 'replicaof|slaveof' /etc/redis/redis.conf || echo "no replicaof in config file"; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication | grep -E 'role|master_host|connected_slaves'; redis-cli -p 6380 ping; /opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 ping; /opt/redis-7.2/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 info replication | grep -E 'role|connected_slaves'
